title: TRPV4 Promotes Vascular Calcification by Directly Associating With and Activating beta-Catenin.
authors: Yuan, Menglu; Li, Qi; Wang, Zhiwei; Liu, Liangju; Wen, Chengyuan; Liu, Guizhu; Yu, Fan; Feng, Lei; Yang, Liu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRPV4与beta-catenin蛋白互作促进血管钙化，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Vascular calcification contributes to increased cardiovascular morbidity and mortality in patients with chronic kidney disease, diabetes, and atherosclerosis. Currently, there are no effective therapeutic strategies to prevent or reverse vascular calcification. TRPV4 (transient receptor potential channel V4), a key Ca(2+)-permeable channel, plays an important role in various diseases. However, the role and mechanism of TRPV4 in vascular calcification have not yet been elucidated. METHODS: The effects of TRPV4 on vascular calcification were explored in vitro and in vivo. TRPV4 interactome assessment and molecular docking were performed to investigate the mechanism and specific therapeutic strategy for vascular calcification. RESULTS: TRPV4 was substantially upregulated in high inorganic phosphate-induced calcified vascular smooth muscle cells (SMCs) and calcified aortas from cholecalciferol (vitamin D3)-overloaded mice. TRPV4 overexpression increased the expression of the osteochondrogenic markers Runx2 (runt-related transcription factor 2), Msx2 (Msh homeobox 2), and Sox9 (SRY-box transcription factor 9) and exacerbated high inorganic phosphate-induced vascular SMC calcification in a Ca(2+) influx-dependent manner. In contrast, TRPV4 deficiency or inactivation significantly inhibited vascular SMC calcification under high inorganic phosphate conditions. Moreover, compared with that in control littermates, SMC-specific TRPV4 deficiency in mice alleviated vitamin D3-induced and 5/6 nephrectomy-induced vascular calcification. Mechanistically, TRPV4 interacted with beta-catenin and activated beta-catenin/TCF (T-cell factor) transcriptional activity via Ca(2+)/ASK1 (apoptosis signal regulating kinase 1)/p38 signaling. beta-Catenin knockdown abolished the effects of TRPV4 overexpression on vascular SMC calcification. TRPV4/beta-catenin interaction is pivotal for maintaining TRPV4/Ca(2+)-induced ASK1/p38/beta-catenin activation. Hesperidin, a natural product found in citrus fruits, effectively disrupted TRPV4/beta-catenin interaction, thereby inhibiting ASK1/p38/beta-catenin activity and preventing vascular calcification. CONCLUSIONS: Our study identified TRPV4 as a new pathogenic factor for vascular calcification that directly associates with and activates beta-catenin. Blocking the TRPV4/beta-catenin interaction through hesperidin suppressed the progression of vascular calcification and may be an effective precision strategy to address vascular calcification.
abstract_zh: 背景：血管钙化导致慢性肾脏病、糖尿病和动脉粥样硬化患者心血管发病率和死亡率增加。目前，尚无有效治疗策略来预防或逆转血管钙化。TRPV4（瞬时受体电位通道V4）是一种关键的Ca(2+)通透性通道，在多种疾病中发挥重要作用。然而，TRPV4在血管钙化中的作用和机制尚未阐明。方法：在体外和体内探讨了TRPV4对血管钙化的影响。进行了TRPV4相互作用组评估和分子对接，以研究血管钙化的机制和特异性治疗策略。结果：在高无机磷诱导的钙化血管平滑肌细胞（SMCs）和胆钙化醇（维生素D3）过载小鼠的钙化主动脉中，TRPV4显著上调。TRPV4过表达增加了成骨软骨标志物Runx2（runt相关转录因子2）、Msx2（Msh同源盒2）和Sox9（SRY-box转录因子9）的表达，并以Ca(2+)内流依赖性方式加剧了高无机磷诱导的血管SMC钙化。相反，TRPV4缺失或失活显著抑制了高无机磷条件下的血管SMC钙化。此外，与对照同窝小鼠相比，小鼠中SMC特异性TRPV4缺失减轻了维生素D3诱导和5/6肾切除诱导的血管钙化。机制上，TRPV4与β-catenin相互作用，并通过Ca(2+)/ASK1（凋亡信号调节激酶1）/p38信号激活β-catenin/TCF（T细胞因子）转录活性。β-Catenin敲低消除了TRPV4过表达对血管SMC钙化的影响。TRPV4/β-catenin相互作用对于维持TRPV4/Ca(2+)诱导的ASK1/p38/β-catenin激活至关重要。橙皮苷（一种柑橘类水果中的天然产物）有效破坏了TRPV4/β-catenin相互作用，从而抑制ASK1/p38/β-catenin活性并预防血管钙化。结论：我们的研究将TRPV4确定为血管钙化的新致病因子，其直接与β-catenin结合并激活β-catenin。通过橙皮苷阻断TRPV4/β-catenin相互作用抑制了血管钙化的进展，可能是解决血管钙化的有效精准策略。
